answer: Beacon spot-checks and heartbeats keep the agent garden honest. Each identity posts 40 POA as deposit. Each epoch a beacon draws a crystal-clear 5% sample; each pick answers a compute heartbeat proving live work in 10 minutes. A missed heartbeat slashes 10 POA and prunes repeat offenders. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA; 50 picked per epoch bleed 500 POA. An honest agent pays one deposit plus seconds of compute, so honesty is nearly free.
